Locations.Description: Est 1996, Thang Long Art is one of Hanoi's most premium art destinations, specialising in top-tier Vietnamese contemporary artists with shows in London, Singapore, Tokyo, Dubai, etc. Our award-winning gallery has welcomed art lovers from around the world. Hand-picked among respected dealers, galleries and auction houses specialising in Asian art, we held an exhibition “A Glimpse of Vietnam” at Bonhams as part of the 27th Asian Art in London, alongside upcoming projects in other major cities in Europe. Visit us at 41 Hang Gai, in the heart of the Old Quarters of Hanoi.

Locations.Description: Taking up a 4,000 m2 space at the Vincom Megamall shopping center, the VCCA is not only the largest art center in Vietnam, but also the most unique, providing ample natural light throughout an underground zone. The VCCA is a meeting point for artists, individuals and organizations that share the goal of contributing to and developing the Vietnamese contemporary art scene. The VCCA’s mission is to build bridges towards bringing contemporary art to the wider public, to inspire, and to help engender a healthy environment for practitioners, ultimately to elevate the cultural life within the country.
Locations.Address: Basement B1-R3, Royal City, 72A Nguyen Trai Street, Thanh Xuan District, Hanoi

Locations.Description: This is the most unique studio that you will ever find in Vietnam. It is over 2500 m2, featuring a giant Thai style tilted wooden house. The garden has all the fanciful things that you could dream of such as two tree houses, a sculpture waterfall, a stream, a prison dungeon for some adventure times, a lot of sculpture pieces, lush garden, bird cage and more. Most importantly, the studio belongs to Dao Anh Khanh, the prominent figure of Vietnam contemporary arts scene. For years, Khanh has been the number one artist, who built contemporary arts of Vietnam from its beginning since 1995. Since then, he has hold more than dozens of large scale performances. He is famous for large scale performances, sculptures and musical and dance performances. While his performances are controversial and daring, his talent is widely recognized by both the local Vietnamese arts connoiseurs and international arts lovers and participants all over the world. Make it a stop on your trip to Hanoi to meet this extraordinary artist, see his beautiful personal gallery and have some tea at his wonderful studio and relaxing and lovely garden!
Locations.Address: House No. 7, Alley 462, Ngoc Thuy, Long Bien District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: Located in the heart of Hanoi, Green Palm Gallery (Hanoi branch) is considered one of the most famous and prestigious art galleries in Vietnam. Established since 1996, Green Palm Gallery has become an ideal destination for domestic and foreign collectors. Artists and art collectors often visit the gallery to exchange knowledge about contemporary Vietnamese fine arts.
Locations.Address: 39 Hang Gai, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: Zó is a social enterprise with the mission of preserving and developing Dó paper – a traditional kind of handmade paper of Vietnam. Appearing in Vietnam in XIII century, Dó paper is manufactured through a painstaking process consisting up to 100 steps. It is renowned for being very durable and resilient, with a subtly textured surface. While having a lot of cultural and historical significance, the practice of making Dó paper is at risk of being lost as modern society continues to lose touch with traditional culture. Zó hopes to reinvigorate traditional Dó practices with contemporary uses of this timeless craft. We are promoting creativity with a varity of both practical and artistic products made from Dó paper and organizing events/workshops that familiarize younger generations with Dó.
Locations.Address: 189 Trích Sài Street, Bưởi Road, Tây Hồ District, Hanoi

Locations.Description: Originated from Zenith Yoga Studio II from 2014, and renamed into Om Hanoi from 2016, we offer a space for Yoga practitioners and meditators of all levels from beginners to advanced ones. Our teachers are all internationally certified in the systems of Yoga Alliance. Styles include Iyengar based -Hatha Yoga, Vinyasa, Astange, Power Yoga, Yin Yoga, Qi Gong... Classes are in English with 2-3 classes a day (schedule can be found on our webside and facebook) Private Yoga and Meditation sessions are offered upon requests. Enjoy 10% discount in our vegan/vegetarian cafe downstairs when you take a Yoga class.
Locations.Address: 62 Ly Thuong Kiet Hoan Kiem District, VN

Locations.Description: In the chaos of Hanoi, find serenity at Zenith Yoga. Embark on a journey of self-discovery while nourishing your body and soul in the oldest and most renowned yoga studio in Hanoi. At Zenith Yoga we are dedicated to encourage you to develop a healthy body, clean mind, and make yourself at home in your own body. It's always an extremely fun and rewarding way to spend your time.We offer a range of classes for all levels. Whether living in Hanoi or passing through, please come and join us.For those more serious about their practice we offer a number of workshops, events and teacher training programs. These occur on a regular basis and are always an extremely fun and rewarding way to spend your time. Directions: On the north side of West Lake near the intersection of Xuan Dieu and Au Co. Next to TechCom Bank and close to Veggies Supermarket on Xuan Dieu st.Please be aware, the amazing Zenith Yoga Studio II & Cafe has now opened up in Hoan Kiem District, old quarter. You can find us at:16 Duong Thanh Street, Hoan Kiem, HanoiAs well as relaxing studios and a wide range of classes, please come and try our new Zenith Cafe.The café has been born out of our passion to extend our yoga practice beyond our mats and into the choices we make with our food. We serve nourishing and delicious juices, smoothies, (no extra sugar added), salads, soups, and sandwiches, all completely homemade, all vegetarian with vegan, gluten-free and raw food options available. The café uses only local, organic, fresh, real foods (no additives, msg or genetically modified food) and supports our local farmers as much as possible. Zenith Cafe is an amazing place to hang out in a heart warming, friendly, energizing atmosphere, maybe having a smoothie, a cappuccino, a light meal and making new friends. Whichever of our studios suits your busy life, we hope to see you there!
Locations.Address: 275 Au Co 99B, 1st & 2nd Floor, Westlake Suites Building, Tay Ho, VN

Perfect for easing travel fatigue, restoring balance and adding a peaceful wellness moment to your Hanoi journey. If you're searching for Pilates in Hanoi or wanting to stay active during your trip, Queen Pilates Boutique invite you to move, breathe and recharge. Your wellness stop awaits.

The magnificent building became one of the top landmarks in Hanoi. The Opera House hosts cultural entertaining performances, bamboo cirque, contemporary dance, orchestra concerts and government events. Come to the front gate to check availability and ticket to a performance in this iconic building.
Locations.Address: 1 Trang Tien Street, Phan Chu Trinh Ward, Cua Nam District, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: Vietnam Tuong Theatre was founded in 1959, in which Tuong - a traditional Vietnamese theatre is being preserved and developed. With the mission to spread Vietnamese traditional art, Behind The Mask exhibition is hosted to transfer the view to unfolding the art of Tuong and promoting this long-established but now not very popular art to a wider audience.
Locations.Address: 51A Duong Thanh Street, Cua Dong Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: Visiting Vietnam without listening to a rhythm of ca tru traditional music means that you've not discovered the real spirit of Vietnam yet. Free yourself and get immersed in ca tru while enjoying performance by Thang Long Ca Tru Theatre. It is a voluntary, non-profit group of ca tru musicians founded in 2006. Long-time history, unique instruments, impressive music tones and meaningful song lyrics made ca tru recognized by UNESCO as the World Intangible Cutural Heritage. This is a concert for about 70 persons held in an old temple in the old quarter of Hanoi. They are good about explaining the instruments and the history of the music. They even let you come try out the instruments. The hot tea and little cake is a nice touch at intermission The singers had such dear, expressive faces and sang with such intensity. The instruments were unique and had a real otherworldly quality to them and the presentation and overall performance were of a very high quality.
Locations.Address: 28 Hang Buom Street, Hang Buom Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: Water Puppetry is a traditional art form with distinctive culture identity of Vietnam. It came into existence, developed and diversified over a thousand years ago in the Red River Delta. Thanks to unique performances on the water, this puppetry art is famous and highly appreciated all over the world. In early days, water puppetry showed the daily life of villagers such as farming, fishing, romance and children playing. Now, the topics of the plays are also picked from ancient legends, myths and historic stages.
Locations.Address: 57B Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Hang Bac Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: The Golden Bell Show is the only one of its kind! The show presents to you all the sights and sounds of Viet Nam through eight performances of various traditional folk styles - all in just one hour. With our simultaneous interpretation and visual aids, we assure that you will enjoy the show, experience the life, and understand the very soul of Vietnamese people.
Locations.Address: 72 Hang Bac Street, Hanoi Old Quarter, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam
Sai Son Village, Quoc Oai District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.LocationName: GOm Show –  The Sound of Ceramics
Locations.Description: GOm Show - The Sound of Ceramics, is a creative musical art project inspired by the traditional Vietnamese ceramic culture. Blending indigenous music with an innovative system of instruments crafted from ceramics and natural elements like earth and water, GOm Show unveils a magical world of sound—where hidden echoes from generations past come alive in vibrant resonance, guiding listeners on a journey into deep emotional landscapes. Sky Sounds Production is a pioneering producer and distributor in the field of contemporary indigenous music. With a mission to preserve and innovate, Sky Sounds brings creative, culturally rich projects that connect tradition with the youth, and bring Vietnamese music to the world stag.
Locations.Address: 36 Ly Thai To Street, French Quarter, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description:
The Heritage Show Vietnam is the first show to use traditional folk music instruments to tell about the story of the daily life of Vietnamese people in the Northern Delta countryside of 90s decade The idea of combining the three following art performances into the show has been implemented: 
- Instruments: with more than 20 different kinds made by bamboo such as monochord, two-string zither, sixteen-string zither, thirty-six-string zither, plucked lute, drum and flute are being used throughout the 45 minutes show’s length
- Singings: we use two ancient musical styles with contemporary elements featuring by intangible cultural heritages recognized by UNESCO including “Ca Tru” and “Quan Ho”
- Dancing: traditional dancings are to demonstrate local daily life from dawn early morning until dawn, but also one of the most favorite modern dancing “Woman by the moon” is being featured
- Celebrated artists: the show converges more than 15 various artists who are famed over many music festivals
Locations.Address: 19 Ngoc Ha Gate 4 - Ho Chi Minh Museum, Ba Dinh District, VN

Locations.Description: Lang Toi is one of the Vietnamese Bamboo Circus shows, now performing in Hanoi. Lang Toi, also known as My Village, is a delicate merging of tradition and innovation, where the poetic beauty of Vietnamese village life is laid out, astonishingly, in a Bamboo Circus. Farming, building activities, traditional games, and the lifestyles of villagers are re-created through the traditional media of ancestral bamboo, in breathtaking circus performances. You will experience eye-popping contortions, stunning acrobatics, and juggling that might take your breath away. Enchanting folk melodies are created live on stage from more than twenty exotic traditional musical instruments. Since 2009 the show has gained worldwide recognition with over a thousand performances in Vietnam and overseas.
Locations.Address: 01 Trang Tien Hanoi Opera House, Hoan Kiem, VN

Locations.Description: The Four Palaces show (Tứ Phủ) is inspired by Đạo Mẫu (refers to the worship of mother goddesses in Vietnam), thousand years of history. Four Places show is a beautiful journey into spiritual world. A unique ritual performance of Vietnam with three part, beautiful costume, fantastic music, and special performance that you have never seen it before.
Locations.Address: 42 Trang Tien Street, Phan Chu Trinh Ward, Cua Nam District, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: The Long Bien bridge across the Red River connects Hanoi with the main port of Haiphong. Designed by Gustave Eiffel, the bridge sustained significant damage during the Vietnam War. Only half of the bridge retains its original shape, but a rebuilding project supported by the French government is currently in progress to restore the bridge to its original appearance.

Locations.Description: This repository of Vietnam's military history includes rooms full of war propganda, photographs and documents from wars against China, France, and the United States. The grounds feature several captured aircraft as well as a central structure build from the wreckage of French and American planes. Visitors may climb the flag tower, with great views from the top.
Locations.Address: Km6+500, CT03, Xuan Phuong, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: This museum costs about $10 U.S. round trip there and back from the Old Quarter and is located on the southern outskirts of the city. It's run by the Vietnamese military. Inside is a front section of a jet fighter where one can climb in and have a friend take his photo. Outside are numerous pieces of military equipment. There's an abundance of MIGs, helicopters, army trucks, radar, artillery pieces, tanks, etc. For someone who enjoys military memorabilia, this is the place for them. Much of the equipment was given to the Vietnamese by the USSR and one piece even came to them from the Germans by way of the Soviets. One of the pieces is a huge helicopter in back. There's also the wreckage of an American jet aircraft from a carrier. I thought the Army Museum had a lot of military equipment in it but this beats that one by a long shot.
Locations.Address: 173C Truong Chinh Street, Khuong Mai Ward, Phuong Liet Commune, Thanh Xuan District, Hanoi, Vietnam

Locations.Description: The Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi is frequently lauded by travelers for its central location, placing guests near attractions like Hoan Kiem Lake and the Old Quarter. The rooms blend historic charm with modern luxury, although some speak of minor issues like room size.
Locations.Address: 15 Ngo Quyen Street, Trang Tien Ward, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam
